doc.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Opening and introduction at Hamilton Jazz Archive
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the filmed interview and asks Allen about the first music that impressed him.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Los Angeles. My name is Monk Rowe, and I’m very pleased to have Steve Allen with me today. I would introduce all the things you’ve done but that would probably take most of the interview.
In that case I’ll be running along.

Please, not yet. But I would like to see if we could talk a bit about your involvement in jazz music today. Your upbringing in vaudeville with your parents and so forth has been pretty well documented. Can you recall the first kind of music that made an impression on you?
